translation.name: A Ch'an Biblia D'a Chuj San Mateo

content: Sb'it jun tic vin̈aj David, yic tzon̈ sc'ayb'ej. Sb'itej jun b'it tic vin̈ cuchb'um d'a b'it ayic ay cusc'olal.

content.text: A eb' chuc spensar sna eb' to malaj Dios. Junlajanxon̈ej ix aj sjuanel spensar eb'. Yelxo val te chuc sc'ulej eb'. Man̈xalaj mach sc'ulan vach'il.
Ato d'a satchaan̈ q'uelanemta Dios d'a anima, yic syila' tato ay eb' syac'och spensar d'ay, yic syilpaxi tato naan yuj eb'.
A juntzan̈ b'eyb'al chuc sb'eyb'alej eb' smasanil. Junlajanxon̈ej tz'aj sjuvib'at eb'. Man̈xalaj junoc mach tzato b'eyb'alan vach' b'eyb'al. Toton man̈xa val junoc.
Icha val to malaj spensar eb' sc'ulan chucal chi'. A eb' chi' satanel eb' yetchon̈ab', icha val to svael eb' yaj eb', max yal-laj sb'a eb' d'a Dios.
Tz'ib'xi eb' yuj xivelal vach'chom malaj tas xib'tan eb'. A Dios ix saclemancanb'at sb'aquil eb' ajc'ool, q'uixvelal ix ajcan eb' yujto ix paticajel eb' yuj Dios.
Comonoc a d'a tzalan Sion scot co colnab'il a on̈ israel on̈ tic. Ayic ol yac'anxi svach'c'olal Dios d'a quib'an̈, ol tzalaj co c'ool a on̈ yin̈til on̈ vin̈aj Jacob tic. Ol el lenaj ol quila'.
